key_big: Plants and animals depend on each other.
key_sub: Birds live in nests, bees in hives, rabbits in burrows.
body_html:
How to think about it

Animals live in many kinds of homes: birds in nests, bees in hives, rabbits in burrows, spiders in webs and lions in dens. Some animals live in trees, some on land and some in water. Their home and surroundings are their habitat.

Some animals eat only plants (cows), some eat other animals (lions) and some eat both (crows). Plants give animals food and shelter; animals help plants by carrying pollen and spreading seeds.

Example

Where does a bee live?

many bees together

Answer: in a hive

Example

Does a lion eat plants?

it hunts

Answer: no, it eats other animals

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all animals live in nests.
  • Calling a dolphin a fish.
  • Forgetting that animals help plants too.
